 Erin Andrews’ $45 NFL Team Long-Sleeve Tees Are Now as Low as $15
 Athlon Sports Follow Rachel McCarson Sun, November 15, 2026 at 10:44 AM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Sun, November 15, 2026 at 10:44 AM UTC Athlon Sports and Yahoo may earn commission from links in this article.
 There's plenty of NFL action on the way this fall and winter, so now is a great time to grab some new gear to support your favorite team. It's also a great time to snag some holiday gifts for the sports fan in your life. Check out these Women's Wear by Erin Andrews Tie-Front Long Sleeve T-Shirts on sale for as low as $15 at NFL Shop. That's a whopping 67% off the original list price of $45.
 These long-sleeve tees come in a variety of styles representing various NFL teams across the country. You can grab the New York Jets Wear by Erin Andrews Green Tie-Front Long Sleeve T-Shirt for $15, but there are many others on sale for big discounts, too. You can also grab tees repping the Miami Dolphins , Minnesota Vikings , San Francisco 49ers , Dallas Cowboys , and more, priced from $18 to $31. 
 Advertisement Advertisement The standout feature of these women's NFL T-shirts is the tie-front design. It gives these raglan-sleeve tees a feminine twist. The listing says the shirts are also "ultra-soft" and provide a "luxuriously comfy feel." The raglan sleeves allow for unrestricted movement, so whether you're chasing after kids or doing your best Brock Purdy impression, you can do so with ease.
 Wear by Erin Andrews Tie-Front Long Sleeve T-Shirts , Starting at $15
 Wear by Erin Andrews Tie-Front Long Sleeve T-Shirts are up to 67% off.Courtesy of NFL Shop
 Shop It 
 Shipping is calculated at checkout. This item is final sale.
 Why We Love This Deal
 I've seen Erin Andrews talk about her apparel line, and she seems genuinely proud of it. With that in mind, it makes it fun to participate in her joy by wearing the clothing. Plus, as a woman, she can tap into styling that works specifically for women. The cherry on top is scoring such a great deal: These Tie-Front Long Sleeve T-Shirts are up to 67% off.
